title: JWKS fetch fails with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED on macOS python.org Python
description: Signed-in /trips returned 401 'unable to get local issuer certificate'. python.org macOS builds ship without system CA certs, so PyJWKClient's urllib fetch of Clerk JWKS failed. Fix: pass ssl_context built from certifi in backend/app/auth.py; add certifi to requirements.
close_reason: Fixed: certifi-backed ssl_context on PyJWKClient; verified JWKS keys fetch.

title: Public share link and mobile itinerary
description: PRD 5.6, 8. Unguessable 128-bit random slug only, no passcode (decided 2026-09-16). Publish toggle off by default; Unpublish and Regenerate link one click; GET /share/{slug} returns stripped payload (no confirmation codes, prices, rejected candidates, gaps, agent internals) with noindex headers. Mobile-first read-only page with sticky map, expandable days, link-outs.

title: Candidate comparison drawer (inbox)
description: PRD 5.5, journey step 6. Drawer over board, 3-5 cards with summary/price/pros/cons/confidence/sources, hover highlights pin, Choose/Not this one/Find more with nudge, rejected footer, failed-job retry. Accept converts Candidate to plan item and closes Gap.

title: Research worker and job queue
description: PRD 6 research agent, 8 worker. Postgres-backed research_jobs table, worker polls, bounded loop using Anthropic's built-in web search tool (web_search_20260318) with max_uses cap, user_location = destination, blocked_domains for aggregators; citations map to Source rows. Search is one pluggable step. Writes Candidate + Place + Source rows, records cost ($10/1k searches + tokens), timeout with partial results, excludes rejected candidates.

title: Planning board: map, day timeline, tabs, gap slots
description: PRD 5.4. Leaflet map with layers, day selector, Overview/Day/Lodging/Activities tabs, empty slots rendered as gaps with Find options and Add manually, side drawer editing.
close_reason: Planning board first cut: GET /trips/:id/board (days, places with locating flag, gaps with lodging night coverage and latest job, lodgings, activities), POST /gaps/:id/research (idempotent, member-only, 409 when filled). City geocoding via Nominatim: server-side, cached in geocode_cache, 1 req/s lock, identifying UA, failed lookups retry after 15 min; triggered on confirm and board load. Worker stub fails jobs with a plain message and reopens the gap. Web: /trips/:id board with Leaflet map (city pins, route line), day picker, Overview/Day/Where to stay/Things to do tabs, gap slots with Find options and polling. Deferred: layer toggles, edit drawer, Add it yourself (travelplanner-uaa). 36 pytest tests; real Nominatim end-to-end located Lisbon, Évora, Porto.

title: Conversational intake and day skeleton
description: PRD 4.2-4.3, 5.2-5.3, 6 intake agent. Free-text intake, extract destinations/dates/travelers/interests, at most two follow-ups, skeleton table editable inline, Confirm creates Trip and Days.
close_reason: Conversational intake shipped: POST /intake/turn (stateless, client holds history + edited draft; Claude Opus 5 structured output, effort medium, server-side fallbacks default; max 2 follow-ups tracked via message kind), POST /intake/confirm (Trip, Days, city Places, lodging-per-stay and activity-per-day gaps), GET /trips/:id/days. Web: chat panel + skeleton editor on /trips/new, day list on trip page. 24 pytest tests; real-API check produced a sensible 10-day Portugal draft (~15s) and a follow-up question for a vague prompt. Browser click-through not yet done by Holly.

title: Sign in and trip list
description: PRD 5.1. Clerk sign-in, trip list cards with title/dates/status/open-gap count, Start a trip button, empty state.
close_reason: Trip cards show status, friendly date range, and open-gap count (open+researching). Start a trip -> /trips/new simple form (to be replaced by conversational intake in travelplanner-o4y) -> /trips/:id placeholder with delete. API: validation (blank title, backwards dates), open_gap_count on list/get, owner-only DELETE with child cleanup, 404 for non-members. 6 pytest tests pass; web build passes.

title: Infra: render.yaml, Postgres, FastAPI skeleton, Vite app, Clerk wiring
description: PRD section 8. One blueprint with web (static), api (FastAPI), worker (Python), db (Postgres). Alembic set up. Clerk JWT verification in API and Clerk React provider in web. Health endpoints.
close_reason: Scaffolded 2026-09-16: backend/ (FastAPI, SQLModel models from data-model.md, Clerk JWT auth, health/me/trips routes, worker loop with compare-and-set job claim, Alembic initial migration), web/ (Vite React TS, React Router, Clerk sign-in/up, trip list page), render.yaml (db + api + worker + static), README. Verified locally: migration applies to SQLite, /health and /health/db 200, /trips 401 without token, worker claims and completes a queued job, frontend builds. Not yet deployed: needs Render + Clerk accounts.

title: Sketch the intake/inbox UI for reviewing agent candidates
description: The research inbox (one candidate per file, curated into canonical data) is the differentiator vs other trip planners. Sketch how it works as a UI: candidate cards with sources/pros/cons/confidence, accept/reject/needs-research actions, promotion into places/options/lodging/transit.
close_reason: Inbox/candidate comparison UI specified in docs/prd.md section 5.5 (drawer over board, side-by-side cards, choose/reject/find more, rejected footer, no JSON/ids).

title: Decide AI-driven vs user-driven balance for gap filling
description: TDF flow was human-curated with agents as researchers (agent proposes candidates into research inbox, human accepts/rejects). Decide whether to keep that 'agent proposes, human decides' shape, how much the app auto-fills (hotels, transit, activities), and where the user must confirm.
close_reason: Decided 2026-09-16: agent proposes, user picks. App drafts days and open gaps; agent researches candidates (lodging, activities, transit) surfaced as friendly cards the user accepts/rejects/asks for more. Mirrors TDF research-inbox flow behind a simple non-technical UI, never raw JSON.

title: Decide target user: personal tool vs product for others
description: Is this just for Holly and Scott, or a product other people use? Decides auth, multi-tenancy (multiple trips/users), and how much polish the editing UI needs. Reference: static TDF planner at https://brenstuhl.com/tdf/ was single-trip, single-author, file-edited.
close_reason: Decided 2026-09-16: product for others. Small scale initially but lightly scalable. Audience is not necessarily tech savvy, so editing UI must be polished and no file editing; needs auth and multi-user, multi-trip data model.

title: Agent cost tracking and internal admin view
description: PRD 9. Store tokens and cost per ResearchJob, roll up per trip, simple admin-only page.

title: Manual add/edit for lodging, activities, transit, places
description: PRD scope table. Forms in the side drawer to add and edit plan items without the agent. Transit is manual-only in v1.

title: Confirm stack: React (Vite) + FastAPI on Render + Render Postgres + Clerk
description: Decided 2026-09-16 (revised from Vercel to Render): Frontend: React + Vite + TS, React Router, Leaflet, deployed as Render static site. Backend: FastAPI as a Render web service (uvicorn). Research agent: Python background worker on Render pulling from a queue, using Anthropic SDK. DB: Render managed Postgres with SQLModel/SQLAlchemy + Alembic. Auth: Clerk (React SDK + FastAPI JWT verification). One render.yaml blueprint. Use starter tier for API and worker so services do not sleep. Reason for Render over Vercel: long-running agent jobs fit a worker better than serverless functions; Python-native.
close_reason: Decided 2026-09-16 (revised): Render instead of Vercel. React+Vite static site, FastAPI web service, Python background worker for the research agent, Render Postgres, Clerk auth. See description.

title: Define data model from TDF schema.md
description: Translate trip-data/schema.md concepts (itinerary day packets, places, options with status ladder, activities, transit legs, lodging stays, sources, research candidates) into database tables for a multi-trip dynamic app.
close_reason: Data model drafted in docs/data-model.md and approved by Holly 2026-09-16 (date-range lodging, Gap as its own table, per-trip Places).

title: Decide how race-specific concepts generalize
description: Stage routes, viewing spots, passage times, caravan times, ArcGIS official route geometry are TDF concepts. Decide whether a general planner models these as one kind of optional 'event anchor' a day can have, and what other event types (concerts, races, festivals) should be supported.
close_reason: Decided 2026-09-16: general trip planner, no TDF-specific concepts in core. Core = days, places, lodging, transit, activities. Optional generic 'event anchor' (race, festival, wedding, conference) may be added later; race becomes one event type. Nothing race-specific in v1.

title: Loyalty and card perks context for the research agent
description: PRD 11a and scope table (later). User lists cards/loyalty programs by name; research agent searches current public benefits and badges candidates where a perk may apply (travel portal bookings, dining credits, airline transfer partners). Dated source per badge, 'may apply' wording, no account access, no redemption. Motivation: Holly hates figuring out how to use Chase Sapphire Reserve points (OpenTable credits, airline transfers).
